# B01 — Cross-tenant and unauthenticated write paths

**Goal:** An outsider cannot write COIs/audit rows, SSRF the droplet, or mirror every tenant into Core.

**Includes:** A2-01, A2-02, A2-03, A2-08, A4-01, A4-02, A5-01/A1-05, A6-02

**Files likely touched (do not edit in this audit PR):**
`server/src/routes/webhooks.js`, `server/src/services/email.js`, `server/src/lib/core.js`, `server/src/routes/vendors.js`, `server/src/routes/integrations.js`, `server/src/scripts/create-webhook-endpoint.js`, `server/src/index.js`, `server/src/lib/core.js`

## Work

1. Require `RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET` in production; always verify Svix (A2-02).
2. Correlate inbound mail to the org that sent the request (header / Reply-To / last UPLOAD_REQUEST for that email **and org**). Never `vendor.findMany({ email })` globally (A2-01, A2-08).
3. Drop `fetch(att.url)` or allowlist Resend hosts + block RFC1918 + 5s timeout (A4-01, A6-02).
4. HTTPS-only webhook URLs; reject private IPs (A4-02).
5. Core mirror only when `vendor.orgId` matches a configured Proof org; default flag off (A2-03).
6. Boot-time env validation: `DATABASE_URL`, JWT secrets ≥32B, webhook secret in prod, `APP_URL` (A5-01).
7. Shared `fetchWithTimeout` for Core (A6-02).

## Tests

WH-1, WH-2, WH-3, J-03 from `/audit/tenant-isolation-tests.md`. Process exits when JWT_SECRET missing.

## Out of scope

Portal tokens (B02). Soft-delete (B03). Sentry (B05).
